prompt:

Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — shade (n.色度): Several paint swatches range from pale blue to deep blue in one hue family, color tone distinctions clear.
TOP RIGHT — observant (a.观察力敏锐的): An adult spots a tiny missing button on another person's coat, pointing gently to the unnoticed detail.
BOTTOM LEFT — greyish (a.浅灰色的): A slightly grey-tinted pale fabric swatch lies beside a pure white swatch, subtle grey coloring visible.
BOTTOM RIGHT — dispel (v.驱散，消除): Sunlight breaks through and disperses a bank of mist around a small house, fog visibly thinning into clear air.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: shade progression within one hue, keenly noticed missing button, slightly grey cloth compared with white, and sunlight dispersing fog. Color distinctions, hands and containment verified.
